newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts regional bells.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman cuts regional bells.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it downgraded several regional bell operating companies.
-- said cut SBC Communications Inc, U S West Communications Group, GTE Corp, BellSouth Corp, Bell Atlantic Corp and Ameritech Corp to neutral from outperform.
-- said believes the deregulatory impacts of share loss, access cuts and pricing pressure will begin to slow the growth rates of regional bells and GTE later this year.
-- said revenue growth rates have peaked.
-- said expects regional bell companies to lose over five percent of market share in the next 18 months.
-- said regional bells may be able to manage earnings per share growth over the next 18 months, but quality will deteriorate. Longer term, earnings volatility will increase.
